entities.name: Prp3
observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt Q09856, Schizosaccharomyces pombe U4/U5/U6 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein Prp3.
Length 542 aa; calculated molecular weight 62,587.98 Da; theoretical pI 9.51; predicted net charge at pH 7 of +18.63.
Pfam domains: PRP3 (PF08572.16), residues 168–378; Prp3_C (PF06544.19), residues 402–535.
Curated function: component of the U4/U5/U6 tri-snRNP; participates in pre-mRNA splicing and nuclear mRNA export.
Curated localization in S. pombe: nucleus, cytoplasm, cytoskeleton, spindle, and spindle pole.
Curated subunit annotation: component of the U4/U5/U6 tri-snRNP complex.
Sequence is highly basic and acidic-region-rich, consistent with a soluble nuclear spliceosomal protein; this is sequence-based interpretation, not a direct localization experiment.

entities.name: U4/U5/U6 tri-snRNP
observations: Prp3 is a component of the U4/U5/U6 tri-snRNP complex involved in spliceosome assembly and pre-mRNA splicing.

entities.name: Pre-mRNA splicing
observations: Prp3 participates in mRNA cis-splicing through the spliceosomal tri-snRNP.
